spatial_claims.claim: ABCDEFGH is a cube with ABCD bottom face, EFGH top face, vertical edges AE, BF, CG, DH. AG is the space diagonal (diameter).
Opposite faces are equal parallelograms with opposite sides equal and parallel.
Midpoints K(AB), L(BC), M(CD), N(DA) on bottom face; O(EF), P(FG), Q(GH), R(HE) on top face.
First cutting plane passes through K, O, Q, M; second cutting plane passes through L, P, R, N.
S is the intersection of diagonals AC and BD of face ABCD; S is midpoint of both AC and BD.
K, S, M are collinear (midline theorem); S lies on line KM in the first cutting plane.
L, S, N are collinear (midline theorem); S lies on line LN in the second cutting plane.
T is intersection of diagonals EG and FH of face EFGH; T is midpoint of both. O, T, Q collinear (T on first plane); P, T, R collinear (T on second plane).
ST is the common section of the two cutting planes within the cube.
AE is parallel and equal to CG (transitivity through BF).
AC is parallel and equal to EG (by I.33 from AE parallel and equal to CG).
ACGE is a planar parallelogram (coplanar by 11.7, opposite sides equal and parallel).
S is midpoint of AC, T is midpoint of EG; AS equal and parallel to TG (corresponding halves of parallel equal segments).
ASTG is a parallelogram with AT parallel and equal to SG (by I.33).
AG and ST are diagonals of parallelogram ASTG and bisect each other at their intersection point.

configuration_map: Cube ABCDEFGH with coordinates A=(0,0,0), B=(1,0,0), C=(1,1,0), D=(0,1,0), E=(0,0,1), F=(1,0,1), G=(1,1,1), H=(0,1,1). Center of bottom face S=(0.5,0.5,0) lies on both cutting planes (x=0.5 and y=0.5). Center of top face T=(0.5,0.5,1) likewise lies on both cutting planes. First cutting plane is x=0.5 (containing K,M,O,Q,S,T). Second cutting plane is y=0.5 (containing L,N,P,R,S,T). Common section ST runs from (0.5,0.5,0) to (0.5,0.5,1). Parallelogram ACGE lies in the plane x=y, with vertices A=(0,0,0), C=(1,1,0), G=(1,1,1), E=(0,0,1). Sub-parallelogram ASGT (perimeter order A,S,G,T) has vertices A=(0,0,0), S=(0.5,0.5,0), G=(1,1,1), T=(0.5,0.5,1), with diagonals AG and ST intersecting at (0.5,0.5,0.5). All positions tracked consistently through every step.
pass_reason: All spatial claims are mutually consistent. The cube labeling, midpoint positions, collinearity arguments (K-S-M and L-S-N via midline theorem), plane membership claims (S and T on both cutting planes), the identification of ST as common section, the construction of parallelogram ACGE, the sub-parallelogram ASGT, and the diagonal bisection of AG and ST are all verified to be geometrically correct and pairwise compatible. Coordinate verification confirms every claim: the two cutting planes are x=0.5 and y=0.5 respectively, their common section is ST, and the diagonals AG and ST of parallelogram ASGT meet at (0.5,0.5,0.5), bisecting each other.
